note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/api/a2a.reason: cinatra#2577 (epic #2564 S8d), on top of the post-#2689 base ceiling: the widget lifecycle READ branch. The three read-only lifecycle pull primitives are now reachable on the `delegated-widget` policy, and the producer (src/lib/lifecycle/lifecycle-pull-mcp.ts) therefore needs a way to build the widget reader real standing — which is two NEW leaves on the locked routes: the live-standing actor (src/lib/lifecycle/widget-lifecycle-frame-actor.ts) and the widget auth-audit sink (src/lib/widget-auth-audit.ts). Uniform +2 on exactly the four routes that mount the MCP server (/sign-in untouched at 218). This record REPLACES the carried #2689 record on the same route: #2689 (the widget OBO token seals, +2) is already IN the base ceiling this raise starts from, so `from` is the post-#2689 value and the delta annotated here is only this PR own +2 — the two branches' new leaves are disjoint, so nothing is double-counted. NARROWING ALREADY APPLIED, and it is the reason this is +2 and not +15: the obvious edge is `widget-lifecycle-actor.ts`, the S8a door, which pulls @/lib/widget-user-auth and its synchronous postgres store leaf for a `cwu_` consume a widget MCP frame never performs. That module was SPLIT so the producer imports only the live-standing half; both entries still call one resolver, pinned by widget-lifecycle-actor-parity.test.ts. Further narrowing considered and rejected: dropping the audit sink would remove the authz audit trail from a security-relevant read path (and the analyzer follows dynamic import(), so deferring buys nothing). Measured as a uniform +2 delta against a clean origin/main worktree in the same environment, re-based onto the post-#2689 main.

/chat.reason: cinatra#2683 (epic #2564 S8f), on top of the post-#2577 base ceiling (itself rebased onto the post-#2689 main): the ONE conversation column. The owner's ruling for this slice is that /chat and /embed/assistant render the SAME conversation-column component, so /chat's column moved out of chat-page.tsx into packages/chat/src/conversation-column.tsx and the widget mounts it. That is +2 NEW leaves on /chat and only /chat: the column itself, and packages/chat/src/app-route-link.tsx — the link policy the column needs, which reads the EXISTING lifecycle host-adaptation seam instead of adding a second per-surface flag. Both are dependency-free within the graph: the column imports exactly what chat-page.tsx already imported (the message list through the same next/dynamic boundary, the composer, the one turn driver, the widget runtime), and the link module imports next/link plus the already-reachable lifecycle runtime. NARROWING CONSIDERED AND REJECTED: folding the link policy into chat-error-display.tsx would have saved the leaf but split the policy across two files (the message list needs it for the sender-profile links), which is the duplication this slice exists to remove; and keeping the column inline in chat-page.tsx is the defect itself — it is what made the widget grow its own reduced copy. Measured as +2 on /chat vs the clean base (1306 -> 1308 reachable modules, both measured in the same environment; the absolute ceiling moves with the base, the delta does not), with /sign-in, /api/mcp, /api/a2a and /api/llm-bridge all unchanged: none of them reaches chat UI.
